(23 folios of individual promoters and 4 folios of Bodies Corporate). Based on email dated 21 January 2016 and 15 July 2016 received from BSE, the total number of individual promoters are revised to 13 instead of 23 in the Table I and II by consolidating different folios on the basis of same PAN. As such total number of shareholders under promoter and promoter group in the Table I and II are appearing as 17. (13 - Individual promoters and 4 - Bodies Corporate). As such, the total number of public shareholders appearing in table I and III are 130610. In view of aforesaid revision in disclosure, the total number of shareholders of the Company are appearing as 130627 instead of 133195.
